selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: Who came to the soldier after some time?
questions.answer: A tricky, bad-looking man came to him.

questions.question: How can you tell he is a tempter?
questions.answer: He offers sinful fun and tells the soldier to give up helpful things.

questions.question: Why did the trickster dislike the recitation?
questions.answer: He thought it would interrupt the fun he wanted.

questions.question: What two things did the marked paper stand for?
questions.answer: It stood for travel help and food help.

questions.question: How much was the soldier affected by the trickster?
questions.answer: He was a little fooled by him.

questions.question: Did the soldier stay strong right away?
questions.answer: No. He started to be pulled in a little.

questions.question: What was the soldier first told to remember?
questions.answer: He was told not to let himself be deceived.

questions.question: What should happen if he cannot do them?
questions.answer: He should stop talking.

questions.question: What lay ahead of the soldier?
questions.answer: A journey lay ahead.

questions.question: What kind of person does the passage show the new man to be?
questions.answer: He is sneaky and harmful.

questions.question: What kinds of things did the man bring?
questions.answer: He brought fancy things, pretty pictures, make-believe ideas, and drinks that make people lose control.

questions.question: What spiritual thing was the soldier using with his mouth?
questions.answer: He was using a talisman.

questions.question: How does the passage describe the man’s methods?
questions.answer: It says he used many clever tricks.

questions.question: From which side did the warning come?
questions.answer: It came from the right.

questions.question: What happened suddenly from the right side?
questions.answer: A loud warning voice came.

questions.question: What was the soldier doing when the sneaky man came?
questions.answer: He was quietly reciting something.

questions.question: What did the man ask about the soldier’s quiet words?
questions.answer: He asked what he was repeating softly.

questions.question: What was the soldier quietly saying?
questions.answer: He was saying a special prayer-like protection.

questions.question: What preparing things did the soldier also have?
questions.answer: He had a travel ticket and a ration card.

questions.question: What season did the man mention when trying to mislead him?
questions.answer: He mentioned spring.

questions.question: What sentence in the passage gives a warning for all people?
questions.answer: It teaches that people can be fooled.

questions.question: What did the soldier say he was reciting?
questions.answer: A talisman.

questions.question: What came from the right side at once?
questions.answer: A strong warning voice came.

questions.question: What four impossible jobs was the trickster challenged to do?
questions.answer: Kill the lion, remove the gallows, stop the wounds, and prevent the journey.
